text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Wassuuup! How's everybody doin'!?
We are in da Nakayama☆ right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ruby, Miracle, and everyone else!
Go all out and show 'em what you got~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone watching on Umastagram,
please give us lots of support!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes.
Daitaku Helios came to cheer alongside
Mejiro Palmer, just as promised.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, everyone looks so strong!
Their muscles are wild."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios, didn't you actually wanna run?
After all the work you put in at summer camp, too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Well, this kinda thing is fresh and fun!
Plus, I'm with Pamachin☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We can't be twinning in races~.
Our schedules don't overlap at all, right!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
Well, it can't be helped!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Let's stay together all day today!
I'm never letting you go☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Kyun! Seriously, so adorbs!
choice_data_list: I wonder if everyone's coming out soon.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A promise...
I will keep it, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby. If you can believe in me, and promise me this—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I know I can make a "miracle" happen.
A dazzling miracle...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "...This is simply too convenient. I—"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Focus on your own race.
Even so, if you're willing to entrust things to me on top of that—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Will you... call my name this time?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Miss... Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —That's more than enough reason to give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It's Zephyr!
Whew~, that's a nice breeze blowing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Yamanin Zephyr... She's a year younger, and she carries this mysterious aura about her. Definitely one to watch on the sprint tracks."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Helios, you're pretty close with Zephyr too, aren't you?
Her vocabulary's kinda unique, though...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's all about the vibes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Here it comes—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyyyy~!!
Ruby! Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Super cute and mega tight!!
Fighting!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't both of them kind of amazing?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right!
So freakin' cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's true, but how should I put it...
It's more like I can feel an incredible presence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Every girl is serious when entering a race, but from those two today, I can feel a resolve bordering on sheer desperation.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Such intensity...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm in! Fellow hardship sufferers, right!
The hardship is intense!
choice_data_list: That's not right, but somehow it still makes sense...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, she's seriously amazing!
After all, Miracle said so!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: We can surpass God in today's race☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's true!
Her aura is completely overflowing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's enough...
to freak me out a bit...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I came to cheer!
This is seriously gonna be a race like nothing we've ever seen before☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That premonition came true... in the worst possible way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"On the final straight, the Umamusume launch their last spurts.
It seemed K.S.Miracle would pick up speed as well, but then—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Looks like Miracle is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle slowly falls behind, all alone.
And at the end—she could barely even walk.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Huh? What?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Crossing the finish line in 1st place is Daiichi Ruby!
It's Daiichi Ruby!

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
Hey!!
What are you doing, get a stretcher over here!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text: Hurry!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to lead the flustered pair away, I happened to look toward the Winner's Circle—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daiichi Ruby, who seemed to have just realized the situation, was left at a loss for words—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Sorry to keep you waiting...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miracle, is that...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Not you too, Helios...
Don't look at me like that.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's just that a dreamlike miracle
has come to an end... that's all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On that day, the newspapers quietly reported the facts.
"K.S.Miracle's Racing Career Cut Short"
"Prospects of Returning to Racing Bleak"—
